title: Influence of Biphasic β -TCP with and without the use of collagen membranes on bone healing of surgically critical size defects. A radiological, histological, and histomorphometric study
authors: Calvo-Guirado JL, Ramirez-Fernandez MP, Degaldo-Ruiz RA. 2014. Clin Oral Implants Res.; 25(11):1228-38. [Epub 2013]. * Study refers to Alveoprotect (Bredent), which was a former private label of Jason® fleece.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Biphasic calcium phosphate functioned well as a scaffolding material allowing mineralized tissue formation. Furthermore, the addiction of absorbable collagen membranes enhanced bone gain compared with non-membrane-treated sites” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
